machineryV1.reason: Subnative fine texture collapses to isolated sparkle.

machineryV2.reason: Coherent coarse logical clusters preserve outlines, rivets, thread and worn iron/bronze construction at native size. Pack/anchors not yet approved.

backgroundV1.reason: Native density direction acceptable, but baked static water/reflections obscure continuous opaque foundations.

backgroundV2.reason: Coarse readable masonry/iron with continuous opaque foundations; no baked water.

extrasV1.reason: Fine face texture/rust and layered highlights collapse to stipple at intended cradle/nozzle density.

floraV1.reason: Leaf rib/checker texture is subnative; first species changes branch family/height between supposed sway poses.

terrainV1.reason: Density direction acceptable, but iron panel/scrawl texture lacks required broad basalt mortar; bottom row bakes water.

extrasV2.reason: Broad logical iron/rust planes and rivets survive intended cradle/nozzle density; open cavities retained.

floraV2.reason: Simple 3-tone blades and matching branch families between sway rows.

terrainV2.reason: Readable large basalt/mortar and restrained iron seams at 32px cells, without static water.

cradleV3.reason: Individual128cell preserves hard iron/rust clusters and open cavity.

nozzleV3.reason: Individual96cell preserves hard clusters; intentional opaque recessed inner pipe follows original guide/registered art requirement.
